page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 32 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor operating at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, supplying a combined 144 GB of VRAM. This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple domains. The CPU achieves top 10% placement in both single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth is strong, placing in the top 25% for both cached small-block and uncached large-block read operations. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates top 10% performance in LLM inference for prompt processing and text generation using 135M and 7B models. It also ranks in the top 10% for static web serving throughput and database operations.

A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may impact performance consistency compared to dedicated resources. Additionally, the server includes no local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached volumes. Given the high GPU memory capacity and top-tier computational benchmarks, this server is configured for workloads such as large language model inference, image processing, parallelized scientific computing, and database operations.
